premises.text: The majority of educational content is static and linear, making it difficult to address future learner needs.
premises.evidence_span: 98% of this content is both static and linear. Only 2% of it is dynamic.

premises.text: Educational systems take a long time to develop courses, which limits their responsiveness to learner needs.
premises.evidence_span: it'll take them months, if not years, to develop courses.

premises.text: Knowledge AI can generate interactive, bite-sized educational content much faster than traditional methods.
premises.evidence_span: we're able to generate interactive, bite-sized e-education e-learning packages 100 times faster.

premises.text: Knowledge LX generates full learning experiences in near real time.
premises.evidence_span: we generate full learning experiences for any learning goal in near real time.

premises.text: Knowledge as a service can be integrated into existing platforms for distribution.
premises.evidence_span: Knowledge as a service is already being used by multiple platforms who can simply plug us in.

premises.text: Institutions report a significant reduction in cost and time to produce educational content using Knowledge.
premises.evidence_span: it's 100x reduction in cost and time to produce this type of educational content.

premises.text: Knowledge LX connects learners with their desired learning goals through generated content.
premises.evidence_span: We connect learners with their desired learning goals, be it getting a job, completing a project, or obtaining a qualification.

premises.text: Real-life learning experiences can be generated in real time to meet specific needs.
premises.evidence_span: we needed to build a brain-controlled exoskeleton to help her move.

value.text: Learners can access dynamic and personalized educational experiences in real time.
value.evidence_span: a future where we can tap into the learner's intrinsic motivation, and generate real-life learning experiences in real time.

notes: Traction metrics and personal anecdotes excluded as they do not directly support premises.
